Gnani.ai-kasauti: report

1872 results · 156 sentences · seeds 0, 1, 2 · 6 audio conditions · Prisma v2.5 and v3.0 · built 2026-11-09 from sweep5-modifiers.json

Scope: synthetic Hindi (hi-IN) sentences spoken by one Timbre v3.0 voice, damaged with seeded white noise plus a simulated phone line (8 kHz, 300-3400 Hz, approximate mu-law), transcribed with format=transcribe. White noise is not real call noise, and clean TTS from Gnani's own Timbre may be unusually easy for Prisma. Read every number inside that scope.

Same sentence, same noisy clip, both models. Only the clips where the models disagree count: if they were equally good each disagreement would be a coin flip, and p is how likely a split this lopsided is by luck. p below 0.05 means "unlikely to be chance" and says nothing about effect size or about other noise types. The ALL row pools correlated clips (the same sentence at several noise levels) and is optimistic: quote the per-condition rows.

The scorer judges the value, not the writing style, so a number written as words still passes if it is right. "mixed" is digits plus a scale word (50 लाख). A clip where nothing could be extracted is counted under digits.

7. Limits

  • White noise only; real calls have babble, traffic and codec artefacts.
  • mu-law here is an approximation of G.711, not bit-exact.
  • One TTS voice, one language, one STT format; TTS speech from Gnani's own model may be easier than real callers.
  • A text mismatch alone does not say whether TTS or STT was at fault; only failures on clean audio can be separated, and only one was confirmed by listening.
  • The cache can serve stale answers if a model is silently updated under the same name.
